Profile
Skydance Corporation is an American multinational mass media and entertainment conglomerate headquartered at One Astor Plaza in Times Square, Midtown Manhattan, with primary creative centers at the Paramount lot in Hollywood and the Warner Bros. lot in Burbank. Founded on August 7, 2025 as Paramount Skydance, it was formed through the merger of Paramount Global and Skydance Media. Shortly after, it pursued an acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery, with the deal closing on October 6, 2026. Upon the acquisition's completion, the company renamed itself as Skydance. David Ellison leads Skydance as its chairman and CEO alongside co-CEO Ynon Kreiz, and the company trades on the New York Stock Exchange under the ticker symbol SKYD. Ellison and his father Larry Ellison own the majority of the company, with a 77.5% majority stake of Skydance's voting shares and 47.2% of all shares. RedBird Capital owns a minority stake composed of 22.5% of the voting shares and 13% of all shares. Skydance operates one of the largest film and television production businesses in Hollywood, and its studio operations include two major film studios Paramount Pictures and Warner Bros. Wikipedia
